sloka: उत्तरं नहि वक्तव्यं ज्येष्ठेनाभिहिते पुनः ।अधर्मसहितं चैव परलोकविवर्जितम् ।। ७.६३.६ ॥
transliteration: uttaraṁ nahi vaktavyaṁ jyeṣṭhenābhihite punaḥ ।adharmasahitaṁ caiva paralokavivarjitam ।। 7.63.6 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, a reply should not be spoken again when commanded by the elder brother, as doing so is unrighteous and leads to no good in the afterlife.
translations.hindi: अध्य, फल, मूल, द्वारा सत्कारित हो, महाराज उन मुनियों के साथ बैठे
